target_customer: Media publishers and content teams that produce high volumes of video (news and sports outlets, creator businesses)
problem: Video editing is slow and manual; teams want agents that handle most of an edit automatically so people only finish in the editor.
business_model: Software subscription with a free tier and paid plans for AI processing, plus enterprise deployments with media companies
product_category: Agentic video editing and video understanding

founders.name: Adish Jain
education: Berkeley (listed in prior experience, degree not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists engineering at Tesla, AWS and Berkeley.

founders.name: Kyle Wade
founders.background_notes: YC page lists ML researcher at UCSD and software engineer at Tesla.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal video understanding and an agent runtime that can edit video reliably is hard; the company published research on topics like caption placement.

defensibility.rationale: Large players and many startups offer AI editing; media customers and workflow integration give modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors such as OpusClip added agent and MCP features; no incumbent had acquired Mosaic as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Short form video demand and AI model progress in 2025; the company reports publishers such as talkSPORT tripling vertical video output (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses mosaic.so; the founders also appear to use usemosaic.ai for email. A separate YC company called Mosaic (mosaic.inc) exists.
branding.community_and_virality: Company claims 100,000+ users and public praise from several tech figures; Launch HN thread; won a Google Gemini and SaaStr competition in March 2025 (company claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Generic dictionary name shared with other YC companies and many tools; the product name Motion is more distinctive, and community praise is company reported.

pivots.from: Video editor with multimodal chat copilot
pivots.to: Node based canvas for building video editing agents, later the Motion general video agent
pivots.why: Founders say they moved toward agents that handle 80 to 90 percent of an edit automatically.

outcome_analysis: Mosaic is active and raised a seed announced April 2026 from YC, Mayfield, Elevation and News Corp. It evolved from a chat copilot to a canvas of editing agents and then Motion, with media publishers as named customers. The space is crowded, so defensibility rests on execution and publisher relationships.
notes: Funding conflict: the YC page cites an April 7, 2026 headline of a $3.8M seed, while the company site states a $4.3M raise announced the same date and $4.3M total; $4.3M used, from the company's own site. Aggregators also list $500K pre-seed, unverified. No dated competitor sources near the batch, so the list is empty (comparison blogs are from 2026). Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown.
